notes.title: Quick, minor Update
notes.notes:
We quickly fix some minor issues and improved some aspect of the game.

Thank you for your amazing support and feedbacks.

notes.title: 🎉 It's Here: A New Update Has Arrived! 🎮
notes.notes:
We care deeply about your enjoyment and satisfaction. That’s why, thanks to your numerous and valuable feedback, we’ve created a truly amazing update.

Available right now, this update brings many improvements and refinements throughout the game.

One of the most exciting additions is a fun yet unsettling animation that plays when you get caught by the entities in the BRAINROOMS!

🔥 Discover all the new features, play BRAINROOMS – BRAINROT BACKROOMS now!

notes.title: New update! We have brought many new features and improvements:
notes.notes:
We've been online for a few days and already many people have joined us playing our video game and leaving positive reviews!
And for that we want to thank you!

A crazy update is now available:
- Added the weapon wheel (activated with the right mouse button) which brings with it 8 different objects to throw at the entities (all weapons will be available after completing the story mode)
- We added a feedback UI when throwing an object (remember to hold down the right mouse button to charge the throw)
- Added two new levels and their achievements (If you have already completed the story you can play them from the main menu and still get the achievements once you complete the level)
- You reported that the camera shake can be annoying, so we added some settings to reduce or increase the camera shake and bob
- Entities now know 10 more new dances than before
- We also added a drone mode unlockable by completing the main story, to take awesome photos or videos inside the game

We can't wait to see you play! Send us your feedback to improve the game more and more and make you have a lot of fun!
